“蓝枫，我们也回去了，有什么事直接去八号院三一五宿舍找我。另外，雪儿的宿舍在三号院。”紧随秦猛之后，杨战也提出了告辞。
于苓歌而言，丸子便是她的精神支柱，她母子相依相伴一千年多，于丸子而言，娘亲除了是他可以依赖之人外，亦是他应保护好的人。
我呐呐无言，眼泪却流了下来，为她的无力，为她的痛失，为她的不知所措。
我们众人赶紧往后退，而那凤圣却一步步的逼近，就在这时只听树林里有响动，天空中的鸟呱呱的乱叫看来树林里有什么可怕的东西。时间不大，只见树林里有个东西在游走，紧接着有两盏大灯冲着这个方向照了过来。
韩如风抬头看了一眼那五尾狐狸，只见那该死的野狐狸正对着自己得意的笑呢。
我在外面也点了一炷香，慢慢的等着，谁也不知道纸扎张和他的三个儿子说了什么，眼看一炷香就要点完，我敲了敲门说道：时间差不多了，天意难违，就算有什么舍不得也要看开。

虽然早已猜想到陆水一的目的和十二道街洞有关，赵若知还是吃了一惊，他实在摸不透陆水一是什么人。

The study is always the room with the best light in Buckingham Palace. The east-facing floor-to-ceiling windows face the stretching green shade in the direction of Constitution Hill. The early morning sunlight shines in through the plain gauze curtains, casting fine light and shadow on the light blue wallpaper.
However, although the scenery is beautiful, no one has the time to enjoy it today.
"A hundred feet tall, clothed in colorful rays of light, with complex marks on his forehead..." Mu Xifeng murmured to himself, saying that the gods were describing the appearance of his heaven-opening body, wasn't it?
Looking at the monsters of different shapes and carnivals not far away, my heart trembled for no reason. When I first entered the demon world, I came in the form of a demon, but now... I am in the form of an immortal. I don’t know if they will sense the immortal energy flowing in my body.
"Lan Feng, we have also gone back. If you need anything, go to the 315 dormitory in No. 8 to see me. In addition, Xueer's dormitory is in No. 3." Following Qin Meng, Yang Zhan also said goodbye.
For Lingge, Wanzi is her spiritual support. She and her mother have been together for more than a thousand years. For Wanzi, her mother is not only someone he can rely on, but also someone he should protect.
I was speechless, but tears flowed down, because of her powerlessness, her loss, and her feeling at a loss.
We all hurriedly retreated, but the Phoenix Saint was approaching step by step. At this moment, we only heard noises in the woods, and the birds in the sky were chirping. It seemed that there was something terrible in the woods. It was not long before I saw something walking in the woods, and then two big lights shone in this direction.
Han Rufeng raised his head and glanced at the five-tailed fox, only to see that damn wild fox smiling proudly at him.
I also lit a stick of incense outside and waited slowly. No one knew what Zhizha Zhang said to his three sons. I was about to finish lighting the stick of incense. I knocked on the door and said: It’s almost time. God’s will is inevitable. Even if you are reluctant to leave, you have to look away.

So I gave them some of the guns captured in the victorious battle so that they could protect themselves when they returned.
